Deviation fixture: the ZET general strike of 28 to 29 September 2026. Never a normal-behaviour replay, tuning or fixture day.

# ZET GTFS-RT frame sample, 2026-09-28, 00:00–01:30 Zagreb

**Test fixture only.** These 179 files are a fixture of this repository's tests and nothing else: the Worker never serves them (its static assets are `app/dist`, built from `app/`), no client downloads them and no page links to them. They let the tests named under "What it is for" replay real frames on any machine without the full recordings (hundreds of megabytes a day), which are never committed.

Generated by `scripts/frames-sample.mjs`; edit the script, not this file. Use `--readme-only <fixture-dir>` to refresh this file without changing the frames.

## Source and licence

ZET GTFS-Realtime (https://www.zet.hr/gtfs-rt-protobuf), the `zet-rt` source of `docs/izvori.md`, recorded frame by frame by the twin (`worker/twin/record.ts`) into R2 and pulled with the wrangler loop in `scripts/replay-twin.mjs`. ZET publishes it under the Croatian Open Licence (Otvorena dozvola) and marks the feed "SAMO ZA POTREBE TESTIRANJA". Attribution, verbatim:

> Public dataset by ZET provided under Open license, dataset source http://www.zet.hr/odredbe/datoteke-u-gtfs-formatu/669

## Artefact it belongs to

The frames name trips of ZET's static GTFS feed **000395**: 2,340 of 2,357 tram reports with a trip id (99.279 %) and 285 of 287 distinct tram trip ids are found in `app/public/data/zet-trips.json` (feed 000395). Service prefixes of the tram trip ids: 0_23, 0_25. The network artefact of the same feed is `app/public/data/zet-network.json`, graphHash `7ad4834435980e22`.

If the artefacts are rebuilt from a newer GTFS feed, the trip ids stop joining; what that means for this sample is said under "What it is for".

## How it was cut

```
node scripts/frames-sample.mjs <recordings>/2026/09/27 --from 220000 --to 233000 --out test/fixtures/frames/2026-09-27-2200-2330-collapse --all-modes --every 3
```

`<recordings>` is a local copy of R2's `zet-rt/` prefix. The script refuses an `--out` under any `recordings/` directory, because `.gitignore` ignores `recordings/` at any depth. The cut also passed `--lead` and `--use` with the text of this file's first line and "What it is for" paragraph.

## What it is for

Written for U2 acceptance A4 (`test/accept/service-state.test.ts`, added by U2): the fleet collapse as the strike began, Monday 28 September from 00:00 to 01:30 Zagreb. Fresh positions (vehicles with a position at most 180 s old and not ahead of the header, every 30th frame) fall from 58 at 00:00 to 12 at 00:30 and 4 from 00:45 on, where the same Sunday-to-Monday night a week earlier (20 September) went from 59 to 30 at 00:45 and 13 at 01:25; the service state must read `reduced` by 00:45 Zagreb and never `normal` again. The frames of 00:00:44 and 00:01:14 Zagreb carry seven vehicles stamped 24 h ahead, the ghosts of U0 step 1. Every 3rd frame keeps the fixture budget. The trips join feed 000395 (99.3 % of tram reports). The strike cannot be recorded again: never re-cut this window from another day, and keep the artefacts of its feed with the tests that replay it.
